node.title: Re^2: Why does default $_ only work
node.author: perlfan
node.doctext:
At first glance, it's appears to me as if it's working due to a side effect. [doc://chomp] operates on $_ implicitly, which you are affecting in your example that works. I do not believe chomp is taking the LHS of the assignment and working with $_ like you think it is. Update - I stand corrected - You can actually chomp anything that's an lvalue, including an assignment:... in [doc://chomp]. I do think it's related to you using $_ inconsistently when switching to $selection.

For clarity you probably still want: my $selection = ; chomp ($selection); And your regex seems incorrect, as pointed out by [id://708738]. This may be where using $_ originally got you.
